Two arrested for online medicines fraud targeting Punjab residents; ₹2.66 lakh traced to bank accounts
results.content: Following a complaint on the National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal, the Delhi Police arrested two men for allegedly facilitating a fake website scam; Punjab residents allegedly lost ₹83,257, and ₹2,66,437 was credited to two bank accounts linked to the fraud

Should voting be a fundamental right?
results.content: A recent Indian Express report revealed an unprecedented rift within the EC over alleged unilateral changes to rules, voter additions/deletions, and centralised data access, prompting a re-examination of the argument that the ‘right to vote’ ought to be elevated from a statutory guarantee to a fundamental one
